licence.suspended: This licence is suspended. You can't buy, sell or transport under it until it is restored.
licence.revoked: This licence has been revoked. You can't buy, sell or transport under it.
licence.notValid: This licence is not valid today (expired or not yet started). You can't buy, sell or transport under it.

home.nothingWaiting: Nothing waits for you. Start a new sale when you're ready.

transactions.emptyBody: Sales and purchases you take part in appear here.

transaction.title: Transaction {{reference}}
transaction.cancelBody: The buyer will no longer be able to confirm it. This can't be undone.

sale.title: New sale
sale.gstinHelp: The buyer's 15-character GSTIN, like 24ABCDE1234F1Z5. Letters are capitalised for you.
sale.gstinInvalid: Enter all 15 characters of the GSTIN, like 24ABCDE1234F1Z5.
sale.buyerNeeded: Find the buyer, then confirm it is the right business.
sale.substanceHelp: Only the substances your licences let you sell are listed.
sale.noSellable: None of your licences lets you sell today, so you can't start a sale.
sale.quantityHelp: A number greater than 0, with up to 3 decimal places, like 150 or 12.5.
sale.quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity greater than 0, like 150 or 12.5.
sale.checkHelp: Checks both licences, the limits and your stock before you go on.
sale.twoStep: Above the threshold: the superintendent gives final approval.
sale.checkNeeded: Check the sale before you continue.
sale.transporterNameHelp: The person or company carrying the goods.
sale.transporterIdHelp: The transporter's ID card number or transport licence number.
sale.vehicleHelp: As on the number plate, like GJ01AB1234 (spaces allowed). Letters are capitalised for you.
sale.vehicleInvalid: Enter the vehicle number like GJ01AB1234.
sale.routeHelp: Where the goods go from and to, and the main roads, like Sanand to Bopal via SG Highway.
sale.reviewIntro: Check everything before you send it. The buyer confirms the sale next.
sale.sent: Sent to the buyer for confirmation.
sale.draftRestoredBody: What you entered earlier in this tab is back.

batches.emptyBody: At the end of each review period, the transactions approved in your positions' areas are gathered into a batch for you to review and sign off.
batches.title: Batch {{period}}
batches.noItems: No transactions were approved in this period.
batches.flagIntro: Flag a transaction that needs another look. The officer who approved it is alerted.
batches.flagged: Flag recorded. The officer is alerted.
batches.signOffIntro: Signing off records that you reviewed every transaction in this batch. Flag anything that needs another look first.

authority.ruleChangesHint: Propose a change to the catalogue, or follow your proposals.

register.exactNote: Exact match only. Partial search isn't available, to protect licence holders.

register.gstinHint: All 15 characters. Letters are capitalised for you.
register.numberHint: As printed on the licence, like GJ/AHD/0001.

licenceTypes.emptyBody: Licence types are added through rule changes.
licenceTypes.thresholdsIntro: Above these quantities, the superintendent gives final approval after the officer.
licenceTypes.noThresholds: No approval thresholds yet, so the officer alone approves every sale.

ruleChange.ownDraft: Another Head Authority officer must decide this change.

ruleChange.withdrawBody: It will no longer wait for a decision. This can't be undone, but you can draft it again.

kindHints.APPROVAL_THRESHOLD: The quantity above which the superintendent gives final approval after the officer.

draft.codeHint: 2 to 32 capital letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter, like BEER_BAR. Letters are capitalised for you.

draft.perTransactionAbove: The per-transaction limit can't be above the stock limit.

draft.sent: Rule change sent for a Head Authority decision.
draft.notDrafter: Only the Licensing Authority, the Head Authority and officers holding a district position can draft rule changes.
